_comment: Timings and strengths for the map, draft, post-fight readout and screen transitions (M7 P3). Every ms here follows the animation speed setting (shorter at 1.5x and 2x, zero on skip). UI responses stay within 100-250 ms; tests/ui/overworld/screen_feel_test.gd checks the ranges.

map._comment: hover_ms: how fast a region lights up under the cursor. select_ms: the selection outline pop. capture_ms: the takeover sweep from the region's node across its shape. ring_*: pressure rings pulse once they reach the warning level, faster when imminent. pending_*: the hatched pending cost on the time and grid bars marches and breathes. meter_ms: how long a bar takes to slide to a new value.

act_zoom._comment: The camera pull-back between acts. The zoom length and fade-in come from data/tuning/acts.json (scaled by the animation speed); these add the act title card and dim the panels while the camera moves.

music._comment: One loop per act, crossfaded when the act changes.

draft._comment: Cards flip in one after another, lift under the cursor and snap into the squad bar when picked.

readout._comment: The post-fight count-up: each bot's rows play in order, one bot after another. *_ms are per row; count_step_ms is the time per counted step, capped by count_max_ms. Level-ups and personality shifts hold a little longer as the payoff.

transition._comment: The wipe between the map, the draft, the battle and the readout: the old screen's last frame, cut into bands that drop away one after another over uncover_ms (band_stagger of it spread across the bands).
